'''Kallukoras''' was the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] leader of the [[Xal 3 Armorers' Confederacy|Armorers' Confederacy]] during the early years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. He specialized in armor crafting and weapon repair, and was a native speaker of [[Rodese/Legends|Rodese]].<ref name="Tessent" />

Translated into [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], the name "Kallukoras" meant "one who frightens his enemies into submission".<ref name="Tessent" />
